text: Capture custom events with attached properties from any official SDK
quote: Custom events you capture from any SDK, each with the properties you attach to them.

text: Capture events via HTTP from any language that can send requests
quote: capture events from any language that can send HTTP requests

text: Run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries from any MCP client or AI editor
quote: Run trends, funnels, retention, and SQL queries from any MCP client or AI editor.

text: Steer the whole product from Slack, web, desktop app, or your editor via MCP
quote: You can steer it all from Slack, web, desktop (PostHog Desktop), or your own editor via the MCP.

text: Build insights, assemble into dashboards, share them, and set alerts on key metrics
quote: Build insights, assemble dashboards, share them, and set alerts on the numbers that matter.

text: Session replay plays back real user sessions with a synced DevTools panel showing console logs, network requests, and errors
quote: Session replay records what real users do in your product and plays it back like a DVR, with a synced DevTools panel showing console logs, network requests, and errors at the exact moment they happened.

text: Wrap a change behind a feature flag, gradually roll it out, and disable it instantly without redeploying
quote: Wrap a change in a flag, roll it out to 1% of users, watch what happens, and turn it off the moment something looks wrong – no redeploy, no hotfix.

text: Target flag rollouts by person property, cohort, or group, then view replays/events/exceptions from affected users
quote: Roll out by person property, cohort, or group, then see the session replays, events, and exceptions from the people who got the flag

text: Run A/B experiments with automatic randomization, exposure tracking, and Bayesian or frequentist statistics
quote: PostHog randomizes your users, tracks their exposures, and runs the statistics – Bayesian or frequentist – so you get a real answer instead of a hunch.

text: Query, manage, and modify data throughout the product using SQL
quote: You can use SQL (Structured Query Language) throughout PostHog to manage, query, and modify data.

text: Sync Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other sources to query alongside product data in one SQL query
quote: Sync Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, and dozens of other sources, then query them alongside your events, persons, and sessions in one SQL query

text: Ingest data from existing tools, filter/reshape events during ingestion, and route results onward in realtime or on a schedule
quote: It pulls data in from the tools you already use, lets you filter and reshape events as they're ingested, and sends the result wherever it needs to go – in realtime or on a schedule.

text: Agent pulls stack trace, error message, and metadata to propose a code fix for a crash
quote: "Show me the full stack trace for the most recent crash, then propose a fix." – Pulls the stack trace, error message, and metadata so the agent can suggest code changes.

text: Inject and upload source maps for error tracking
quote: Inject and upload source maps for PostHog error tracking

text: Free self-hosted deployment via Docker Compose under MIT license
quote: We offer a free Docker Compose deployment under an MIT license.

text: Turn product-data signals (errors, rage clicks, failed queries) into researched reports and reviewable pull requests
quote: Turn signals in your product data (errors, rage clicks, failed queries, and more) into researched reports and pull requests you review and merge.

text: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on captured events
quote: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on the events you already send to PostHog

text: Run SQL insights directly with SELECT, FROM, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY

quote: Track errors, get alerts, and resolve issues to improve your product.

text: No-code survey templates plus a custom survey builder
quote: Ask anything with our collection of no-code survey templates, or build custom surveys with our survey builder.

text: GA-like dashboard for monitoring web traffic, sessions, conversion, web vitals, and revenue
quote: Monitor web traffic and user sessions with a GA-like dashboard. Easily monitor conversion, web vitals, and revenue.

text: Capture traces, generations, latency, and cost for LLM-powered apps
quote: Capture traces, generations, latency, and cost for your LLM-powered app.

text: Create workflows that automate actions or send messages to users
quote: Create workflows that automate actions or send messages to your users.

text: Combine all data in a context warehouse queryable directly by users, agents, or dashboards
quote: Combine everything in PostHog's context warehouse so that you, your agents, and your dashboard can query it directly.

text: Define experiment variants and target metrics, with automatic randomization and stats reporting
quote: You define variants, pick the metrics you care about, and PostHog randomizes your users, tracks their exposures, and runs the statistics – Bayesian or frequentist

text: Watch real user session replays to diagnose issues and understand behavior

quote: AI observability: Capture traces, generations, latency, and cost for your LLM-powered app.
